'''ArachSilk''' was a synthetic substance with high tensile strength produced by [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]] and used to make [[Net/Legends|netting]]. The fine-mesh netting used in the ammunition of the [[AO14 net gun]], produced by [[Palandrix Personal Protection Gear]], was made of ArachSilk. The material was strong enough to prevent most animals or [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] escaping from nets made of ArachSilk. It was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ETU" />

==Behind the scenes==
ArachSilk was mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Andrew Fischer]] and released in [[2013]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game.<ref name="ETU" />
